Discussed health as physical, mental and social well-being, not only absence of disease.
Used sleep, stress, food, exercise, friendships and talking as examples.
Siya gave two unaided correct responses across three attempts.
Teach-back was not passed; the lesson ended at Siya’s request.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the three parts of health with Siya using everyday examples such as sleep, exercise, feelings, friendships and talking with a trusted person. Siya correctly explained that health is more than not being ill and identified several relevant examples. Some examples, such as talking with their mother, were placed under both mental and social health; this was not fully resolved before stopping. At home, ask Siya to sort a few examples into physical, mental or social health and explain why.
